| Legend | 
| Icon | Name | Description | 
| ![Level](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/6/61/Icon_level.png) | **Level** | The minimum level which the player character must be in order to equip the weapon. This value cannot be modified once the weapon has been created. | 
| ![Damage per shot](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/7/73/Icon_damage.png) | **Damage** | The damage caused per projectile. The damage is divided evenly between the number of projectiles. [1] | 
| ![Damage per second](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Damage per second (DPS)** | The maximum cyclic damage dealt in one second, expressed as rate of fire times damage divided by 10. *(damage*firerate)/10* | 
| ![Damage per AP](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Damage per AP (DAP)** | The damage dealt per action point, expressed as damage divided by AP cost. *damage/apcost* | 
| ![Critical hit Damage](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Critical damage** | The amount of damage that is *added* when you score a critical strike. Critical strikes can only be triggered manually in V.A.T.S. *2.0 = +100% paper damage* | 
| ![Area of Effect](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Area of effect (AOE)** | The distance radius of explosions. Some explosions have more than 1 radius, each with their own multiplier on damage dealt. | 
| ![Rate of fire](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Fire rate** | The maximum cyclic number of shots/attacks per 10 seconds, without considering reloading. | 
| ![Swing speed](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Swing speed** | The rate at which a melee weapon can attack. | 
| ![Range](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Range** | The distance at which the weapon ceases dealing full damage and applies an out-of-range damage multiplier, as well as the chance to hit in V.A.T.S. | 
| ![Accuracy](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Accuracy** | The cone-of-fire spread as well as the chance to hit in V.A.T.S. | 
| ![Action point cost](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **AP cost** | The number of Action Points used per shot in V.A.T.S. | 
| ![Ammunition used](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Ammunition used** | The type of ammunition the weapon uses. | 
| ![Magazine capacity](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Magazine capacity** | The ammunition capacity of the weapon. | 
| ![Weapon weight](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Weight** | The weight value of the weapon. *Values listed here use the weapon's base weight, that is, before modifications are applied.* | 
| ![Weapon value](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Value** | Base value of the weapon in caps. Buy and sell values are effected by player Barter skill. | 
| ![Value to weight ratio](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Value to weight** | The ratio of the base weapon value in caps to the weapon weight. *value/weight* | 
| ![Gold bullion unlock](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Gold bullion** | Weapon plan is unlocked with gold bullion. | 
| ![Daily Ops unlock](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Daily Ops** | Weapon plan is rewarded from Daily Ops. | 
| ![Fallout 76 limited-time content](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Survival** | Weapon was only available for a limited time during Survival. | 
| ![Nuclear Winter weapons](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Nuclear Winter** | This weapon appears in the Nuclear winter battle royale. | 
| ![Quest reward](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Quests** | Weapon plan is rewarded from Quests. | 
| ![Event reward](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Events** | Weapon plan is rewarded from Events. | 
| ![Public event reward](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Public events** | Weapon plan is rewarded from Public events. | 
| ![Strength](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Strength** | This is a Strength perk. | 
| ![Perception](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Perception** | This is a Perception perk. | 
| ![Endurance](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Endurance** | This is an Endurance perk. | 
| ![Charisma](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Charisma** | This is a Charisma perk. | 
| ![Intelligence](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Intelligence** | This is an Intelligence perk. | 
| ![Agility](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Agility** | This is an Agility perk. | 
| ![Luck](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Luck** | This is a Luck perk. | 
| ![Legendary perk](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Legendary Perk** | This is a Legendary perk. | 
| ![Attack](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Physical** | Damage dealt by ballistic and explosive weapons. | 
| ![Energy](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Energy** | Damage dealt by lasers, electricity and plasma weapons. | 
| ![Radiation](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Radiation** | Damage dealt through radioactive weapons. | 
| ![Fire](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Fire** | Damage from flame-based weapons and explosives, occasionally residual. | 
| ![Cryo](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Cryo** | Damage dealt by cryogenic weaponry. Currently only in use by the war glaive cryo blade, Floater Freezers, and cryo arrows. | 
| ![Acid](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Poison** | Damage dealt by poisoned weapons, usually applied as damage-over-time *(dot)* . | 
| ![Damage](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Pure** | A damage type that currently cannot be resisted. Used exclusively by the wendigo colossus. | 
| ![Explosion](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Explosive** | Area-of-effect damage from explosives. Damage type is borrowed from the weapon. | 
| ![Bleed](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | **Bleed** | Damage-over-time from certain bladed melee weapons/mods. Uses physical damage, but is not resisted by DR. | 
| ![Energy](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) | ![Fallout 76 unused content](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D) **Electrical** | Electrical damage is used only in the Electrically Charged mutation, and but is resisted by Energy Resistance. |
